parameters.content:
## Trellis: Daily Brand Metrics

**Why this exists:** follower counts are the ONLY dashboard metric with no other
source of history. Revenue, new profiles, posts published and email opens are
all computed from dated source rows (`orders.paid_at`, `profiles.created_at`,
`email_events.occurred_at`), so they need no snapshotting and already show real
deltas. Meta only ever reports "right now" — so without this job, a follower
trend is impossible and the dashboard correctly shows no delta at all.

Runs daily at 06:00 → reads active branches → calls the deployed
`meta-insights` function per brand → writes one row per brand/platform/day to
`brand_daily_metrics`.

### Setup after import
Confirm the `Sproutify Trellis` Supabase credential on the three HTTP nodes,
then **activate**. Nothing else.

### What you get
Follower and reach deltas on the Branch Board become real after ~2 days, and a
proper trend after a week. Until then the dashboard keeps rendering no delta
rather than inventing one.

A brand with no Meta connection returns `connected: false` and is skipped —
deliberately writing NO row, because a row of zeros would later read as
"followers dropped to zero".
